title: Synthetic session two
turns: Better. I replied to Dana within the hour on Wednesday and nothing bad happened.
I went for a run first. Running calms me down before hard conversations.
I called my mum on Sunday. Ruth always asks whether I am still at that job, and I felt small again.
What do you make of that?
Ruth and my father both think a real job is one where you never complain.
I used to believe that too. Now I think I need to feel safe to say when something is wrong.
It strikes me that you treat that need as a weakness.
I value honesty more than looking fine.
We are at time. I am away on the second, so let us meet on the ninth.
